A '''hyperlane''' ran from [[Axxila/Legends|Axxila]] to [[Tangrene]] in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].<ref name="TEA" /> This corridor of industrial worlds contained [[Axxila/Legends|Axxila]], [[Edusa]], and [[Vandyne]]. [[Kavil's Corsairs]] were very active on this spacelane during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].<ref name="Hb1">[[Star Wars Handbook 1: X-Wing Rogue Squadron|''Star Wars Handbook'' 1: ''X-Wing Rogue Squadron'']]</ref>
